name: Jackery SolarSaga 100 W Air
summary: A folding 100 W solar panel for weather-dependent charging. Match the station, connector and regional cable before building a backup-power kit.
description: Solar replenishment adds a weather-dependent part to an outage plan. The 100 W figure is a laboratory rating, not a promise of continuous household power. Reserve space for the unfolded panel, plan a cable route and keep a separate charging option for periods when useful sunlight is unavailable.

specs.label: Main charging connection
specs.value: DC8020 via the solar charging cable

specs.label: Direct charging
specs.value: USB-A and USB-C outputs; shared real-world performance not tested

specs.label: Included regional accessories
specs.value: Multifunctional charging cable and DC8020-to-DC7909 adapter listed by Jackery Canada

pros: Folding construction supports storage between outages.
Manufacturer documentation explicitly pairs this panel family with Explorer 1000 v2.
cons: Output depends on sunlight, positioning and temperature.
The Canadian page excludes Explorer 300, 300 v2, 300D and 240D recharging.
This record is for 100 Air, not 100 Light, 100 Prime or the older SolarSaga 100.
useCases: Plan daytime replenishment of an Explorer 1000 v2 using the prescribed cable.
Compare solar placement space against the household outage plan.
